content.text: Having triumphed at last year's Canadian Open, the 28-year-old from Oban has now claimed victory at the Scottish Open, an event jointly sanctioned by the DP World Tour and the PGA Tour.

This year has presented more challenges for Gotterup, as he missed the cut in eight out of his first twelve events. Until this weekend, he had not achieved any top-10 finishes and entered the tournament ranked 88th in the FedEx Cup standings.
McIlroy is vying to regain the Scottish Open title he won in 2023 and head to his homeland on a high after enduring fluctuating form in the wake of the Masters.
